text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After enduring Shinko Windy's<n>pranks for some
time, I begin to<n>notice a pattern.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy drops to second place!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: WAHAHA! Ya fell for it! Ya fell for it!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy fights gamely but falls<n>one step
short!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
AHAHAHA! Gotcha, gotcha! Hey,<n>hey! Heeere,
kitty, kitty!
choice_data_list: (Every time she loses, she comes to bother me!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Defeat seems to kick her prankster<n>instincts into
overdrive. And she<n>always has the biggest smile as
she<n>catches me off guard.
choice_data_list: (I think I see what's going on here...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My theory is that pranking me is her<n>way of venting
frustration after a<n>defeat.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
WAHAHAHA! You've fallen prey to<n>Wicked Windy
yet again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it relieves stress and lets her<n>focus on
training, then...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nobody can stop Windy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following this epiphany, I try to<n>indulge her with
extra-heated<n>reactions.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Neeheehee! Yesterday was another<n>success—a
great success! It's never<n>a bore with that trainer!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And those eyes—starin' at me like<n>crazy every
time! Hehehe! What<n>should I pull next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This continues for a while... until one<n>day, I need to
leave the academy for<n>a few weeks for a career
training<n>program.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Hehehe! Today's prank is<n>gonna be a good
one. I can't wait to<n>see that sweet reaction!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's this piece of paper?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Gone for a training program"...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The program turns out to be more<n>demanding than I
expected. Before I<n>get a chance to breathe, several
weeks have gone by in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I finally make it back to<n>Tracen...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No, no, NO! I'm not running, and that's<n>final!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
But if you keep skipping tryouts, it<n>could lead to
your expulsion...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Shaddup! See if I care! I'm fed up<n>with everything! I
quit!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Ah! Come back here, Shinko Windy!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...So you see, a few weeks ago she<n>declared a
"boycott" and ramped up<n>the mischief.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Classes, for one, and tryout races<n>too. I tried to get
a reason out of her<n>just now, but she can't seem
to<n>explain it herself.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And don't get me started on the<n>pranks... See that
wall over there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The teacher points to a ginormous<n>self-portrait of
Windy graffitied onto a<n>school building.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Us teachers are partly to blame. Her<n>pranks were
getting worse, so I<n>wanted to put a stop to them
before<n>they really got out of control.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I figured she just wants to get a<n>reaction out of us,
so I tried to stay<n>calm to avoid encouraging her...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: But that just seemed to make things<n>worse!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Sigh... At this point, I just want achance to talk things out, but, well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I left for my training program,Windy's pranks were bad, but theyweren't bad bad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take off running after Windy. Soon<n>enough, I find
her standing alone in a<n>quiet corner of the campus.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Races, pranks... Nothing's fun<n>anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I had the wrong idea. I thought<n>pranks were
just her way of letting<n>off steam after a bad race,
but...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's the point? No one gives me a<n>second
glance anymore...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Look at me. Look at Windy!" As I<n>watch her
quivering in frustration, I<n>can't help but feel like
those are the<n>words she's silently crying out.
